title: Cedar Point
description: Cedar Point, in Sandusky, Ohio, is a Lake Erie resort park whose coaster collection is among the largest anywhere, spread from the main midway to the frontier town and the beachfront. Its operating headliners include Millennium Force, Steel Vengeance, Maverick, GateKeeper, and Valravn, alongside a water park, Cedar Point Shores, and a long beach. Its past includes Mean Streak, reborn as Steel Vengeance, the impulse coaster Wicked Twister, and the enclosed Disaster Transport, and the full park is mapped record by record in the companion cedar-point-park pair.
lands_areas: Main Midway, Frontier Town, Camp Snoopy, Gemini Midway, Cedar Point Shores, Marina Gate
rides_new: NEW (operating): Millennium Force (steel coaster); Steel Vengeance (hybrid coaster); Maverick (launched coaster); GateKeeper (wing coaster); Valravn (dive coaster)
rides_past: PAST: Mean Streak (1991-2016, reborn as Steel Vengeance); Wicked Twister (2002-2021); Disaster Transport (1985-2012)
theming_ecosystems: Lake Erie resort theming: a main midway, a frontier town, a camp-themed kids land, and a beachfront boardwalk
hidden_spots: Publicly-known hidden spots: the quiet beach paths at the back of the park, the shaded Frontier Town trails, and the marina-gate walkways

demo.code:
RIDES = [
    ('Millennium Force', 50),
    ('Steel Vengeance', 50),
    ('Maverick', 45),
    ('GateKeeper', 35),
    ('Valravn', 35),
]
print('Wait-time estimate: Cedar Point')
total = 0
for name, wait in RIDES:
    total += wait
    print('%s: %d min' % (name, wait))
print('Rides listed: %d' % len(RIDES))
print('Total queue time if ridden once each: %d min' % total)
print('Average wait: %.1f min' % (total / len(RIDES)))
longest = max(RIDES, key=lambda r: r[1])
print('Longest wait: %s at %d min' % longest)
demo.expected_output:

title: Kings Island
description: Kings Island, in Mason, Ohio, is a park built around International Street, a grand entrance avenue lined with shops and a fountain, leading to a coney midway, a river town, and a German festival area. Its operating coasters include the giga coaster Orion, the wooden Mystic Timbers and The Beast, the inverted Banshee, and the steel Diamondback. Retired names include Son of Beast, Vortex, and Firehawk, while The Beast remains the park's legendary long wooden coaster.
lands_areas: International Street, Action Zone, Coney Mall, Rivertown, Planet Snoopy, Oktoberfest, Area 72
rides_new: NEW (operating): Orion (giga coaster); Mystic Timbers (wooden coaster); Banshee (inverted coaster); Diamondback (steel coaster); The Beast (wooden coaster)
rides_past: PAST: Son of Beast (2000-2012); Vortex (1987-2019); Firehawk (2007-2018)
theming_ecosystems: International-street theming: a grand entrance street, a coney midway, a river town, a German festival area, and an Area 72 space zone
hidden_spots: Publicly-known hidden spots: the shaded Rivertown paths, the quiet corners of Coney Mall, and the back walkways of the Oktoberfest area

demo.code:
RIDES = [
    ('Orion', 10, 45),
    ('Mystic Timbers', 9, 35),
    ('Banshee', 9, 40),
    ('Diamondback', 9, 40),
    ('The Beast', 10, 45),
]
print('One-day itinerary: Kings Island')
plan = sorted(RIDES, key=lambda r: -r[1])
clock = 10 * 60
for name, thrill, wait in plan:
    hh, mm = divmod(clock, 60)
    print('%02d:%02d ride %s (thrill %d/10, wait %d min)' % (hh, mm, name, thrill, wait))
    clock += wait + 15
hh, mm = divmod(clock, 60)
print('Plan ends about %02d:%02d after %d rides' % (hh, mm, len(plan)))
